title: Broadcom May Be the Biggest Winner From Alphabet's Earnings
excerpt: Alphabet raised its 2025 CapEx guidance to $195-$205 billion and posted 82% Cloud growth, signaling stronger TPU and AI infrastructure demand for chip partne...
content_html:
Key Points

  • Interested in Broadcom Inc.? Here are five stocks we like better.

  • Alphabet raised its full-year capital expenditure guidance to $195 billion to $205 billion, roughly 8% above its prior midpoint forecast.

  • Alphabet's Cloud revenue grew 82% year-over-year, far outpacing overall company growth and signaling stronger demand for Broadcom-developed TPUs.

  • Alphabet attributed its CapEx increase to accelerating infrastructure demand rather than memory costs, a distinction analysts view as especially favorable for Broadcom.

Magnificent Seven giant Alphabet (NASDAQ: GOOG) just reported its latest financial results, but the company's earnings have implications for more than Alphabet itself.

Broadcom (NASDAQ: AVGO) has some of the clearest ties to Alphabet, having helped the firm develop its tensor processing units (TPUs) for years. Amid this, Alphabet is widely considered to be Broadcom's largest AI chip customer.

→ Volatility Is Back and These 3 Market Tollbooths Are Best Positioned to Profit

In turn, what Alphabet is seeing from a demand perspective and the spending it forecasts has meaningful consequences for Broadcom. While Alphabet shares tumbled after releasing its results, it's hard not to take the company's numbers as positive indicators for the world's second-largest semiconductor company.

Alphabet's Capital Expenditures Soar, Guidance Gets a Boost

The first notable metric to highlight is Alphabet's capital expenditure (CapEx) and its CapEx forecasts. Alphabet's CapEx in Q2 was $44.9 billion. This equated to an increase of 100% year-over-year (YOY) and a 26% increase quarter-over-quarter. The company notes that the vast majority of this spending went toward infrastructure to support its AI investments.

→ This Tiny AI Supplier Could Be More Important Than the Chipmakers

Alphabet's rapidly increasing AI infrastructure spending is a strong positive indicator for Broadcom. Much of that increased spending goes toward the TPUs Broadcom helps develop, as well as its networking chips.

More importantly, Alphabet also raised its full-year CapEx guidance. Its CapEx forecast now sits at $195 billion to $205 billion. At a midpoint of $200 billion, this is approximately 8% higher than the company's previous midpoint CapEx guidance of $185 billion. This increase raises the ceiling of revenue that Broadcom could generate in 2026.

→ 2 Stocks Built to Thrive If Inflation Refuses to Fade

Additionally, Alphabet is now near the top of the heap in planned hyperscaler CapEx for 2026. Amazon.com (NASDAQ: AMZN) expects to spend $200 billion, Microsoft's (NASDAQ: MSFT) planned CapEx is $190 billion, and Meta Platforms' (NASDAQ: META) is $135 billion at the midpoint. For Broadcom, having a close-knit partnership with the company tied for the highest CapEx guidance among hyperscalers is a great position to be in.

content_html_zh:
要点

  • 对博通公司感兴趣？ 这是我们更喜欢的五只股票。
  • Alphabet 将全年资本支出指引上调至 1,950 亿至 2,050 亿美元，比之前的中点预测高出约 8%。
  • Alphabet 的云收入同比增长 82%，远远超过公司整体增长速度，表明对 Broadcom 开发的 TPU 的需求更加强劲。
  • Alphabet 将其资本支出增加归因于基础设施需求的加速增长，而不是内存成本的增加，分析师认为这一点对博通尤其有利。

七大巨头Alphabet（纳斯达克股票代码：GOOG）刚刚公布了最新的财务业绩，但该公司的盈利影响不仅仅是Alphabet本身。

Broadcom（纳斯达克股票代码：AVGO）与 Alphabet 有着最明确的联系，多年来一直帮助该公司开发张量处理单元（TPU）。 其中，Alphabet被广泛认为是博通最大的人工智能芯片客户。

→ 波动性又回来了，这 3 个市场收费站最有可能获利

反过来，Alphabet 从需求角度看到的情况及其预测的支出对博通产生了有意义的影响。 虽然 Alphabet 股价在公布业绩后大跌，但很难不将该公司的数据视为全球第二大半导体公司的积极指标。

Alphabet 的资本支出飙升，指引得到提振

第一个值得注意的指标是 Alphabet 的资本支出 (CapEx) 及其资本支出预测。 Alphabet 第二季度的资本支出为 449 亿美元。 这相当于同比增长 100%，环比增长 26%。 该公司指出，绝大多数支出都用于基础设施以支持其人工智能投资。

→ 这个小小的人工智能供应商可能比芯片制造商更重要

Alphabet 快速增长的人工智能基础设施支出对博通来说是一个强有力的积极指标。 增加的支出大部分用于博通帮助开发的 TPU 及其网络芯片。

更重要的是，Alphabet 还上调了全年资本支出指引。 目前其资本支出预测为 1,950 亿至 2,050 亿美元。 按 2000 亿美元的中值计算，这比该公司之前 1850 亿美元的中值资本支出指导值高出约 8%。 这一增长提高了博通 2026 年可能产生的收入上限。

→ 如果通胀不消退，两只股票将蓬勃发展

此外，Alphabet 目前在计划的 2026 年超大规模资本支出中名列前茅。 亚马逊（纳斯达克股票代码：AMZN）预计支出 2000 亿美元，微软（纳斯达克股票代码：MSFT）计划的资本支出为 1900 亿美元，Meta Platforms（纳斯达克股票代码：META）的中值为 1350 亿美元。 对于博通来说，与超大规模企业中拥有最高资本支出指导的公司建立密切的合作伙伴关系是一个很好的位置。
